args.subject: Thoughts from last Friday's art exhibition
args.body:
Hi Jack,

Just wanted to share a quick note about the art exhibition I went to last Friday. The abstract paintings really caught my eye — the artists used incredibly vibrant colors and unique textures that made each piece stand out. I even bought a small piece as a souvenir.

I'd love to show you photos or go to the next exhibition together.

Best,

args.subject: Lovely surprise at dinner last night
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to share a sweet moment from our cozy family dinner last night: my sister surprised Mom and Dad with a beautifully decorated cake she baked herself. It was such a heartwarming gesture and made the evening extra special.

Thought you'd appreciate hearing about it.

Best,

args.subject: Music festival last Sunday
args.body:
Hi Bob,

Just a quick note — at the music festival last Sunday I tried out a fun interactive art installation. It was really engaging and a highlight of the day, and I thought you might find it interesting.

Cheers,

args.subject: Artisanal coffee I tried this morning
args.body:
Hi Henry,

Just wanted to share — this morning at the local farmer's market I savored an artisanal coffee from a local vendor. It was delicious: rich and smooth. Thought you might like to know about it.

Thanks,

args.subject: Emma's birthday cake
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I baked a homemade cake for Emma's birthday party last weekend.

Would you like any more details?

Thanks.
